environment: Actual production build, real Supabase JS/SSR clients, controlled Auth/REST transport. No real password or email entered; no provider credits or customer records used.
checks: Actual production-build login, recovery and first-account setup render at 1440/390 without env-password copy or overflow
Mismatched passwords get actionable feedback before any account request
Signup sends the correct confirmation destination and stores PKCE verifier in HttpOnly cookie
Real Supabase SSR client exchanges PKCE code, writes secure HttpOnly account cookies and opens owner dashboard
Verified owner can enter the private Stripe sandbox questionnaire
Password changes through the site and logout removes dashboard access
Old password fails and new password signs in without changing or redeploying Vercel
Password recovery callback goes to the authenticated password form
Expired/replayed links cannot open the studio and offer recovery
Cross-origin login and unauthenticated sync/password changes are denied
Unlisted emails cannot create owner accounts or sign in
Valid customer identity with forged owner metadata is denied dashboard and sandbox
Legacy environment-password cookies cannot authorize studio access
Unconfirmed email identities cannot claim the owner account
Expired access token refreshes through proxy and persists account cookies
Atomic authentication rate limit returns actionable feedback
320/768 layout and client runtime checks pass
